## Summary

Lumina's live site is currently sitting on **InboxZap's** entire SEO history — a prior, unrelated product (consumer email-cleanup tool) the same domain used to run. That mismatch, plus one broken content pipeline, is the real traffic story here.

**Critical fix (applied):** `/blog` was a client-side shell that fetched `/api/posts` — which 404s live. Every visitor and every crawler got an infinite spinner or "Could not load posts." Rewrote it as a working server-rendered page. This had been stranding ~15,000 historical impressions across 12 orphaned legacy posts with no working link path to them.

**Pivot/migration (planned, hand-corrected):** GSC exports show 40 top queries and 13 top pages, all InboxZap-era (gmail filters, bulk-delete emails, inbox zero, etc.) — zero overlap with Lumina's actual positioning. Ran `seoagent migrate`, but its automated relevance scorer got confused by the word "InboxZap" appearing in my own context notes and nonsensically flagged email-cleanup queries as "on-strategy" and the live homepage as "off-strategy." I overrode it by hand: **1 harvest** (keep the homepage as the landing page for residual branded "inboxzap" searches — added a one-line rebrand bridge + FAQ schema) and **52 sunset** (12 orphaned posts + 37 associated legacy queries — off-topic, no honest redirect target, negligible real ranking authority despite impression counts). Full reasoning in `.seoagent/strategy/migration-plan.md`.

**Also fixed in-repo:** `app/layout.tsx` still had stale "InboxZap" fallback title/OG metadata even though the live site already renders Lumina branding everywhere — reconciled it so no future route can silently inherit the old brand.

**Found but couldn't fix (no backing file in this repo):** `/pricing` (missing canonical + schema) and `/features` (duplicate H1s) exist live but have no corresponding source files here — the live deploy appears to be ahead of this repo snapshot. Flagged in `audit/latest.md` for whoever owns that deploy. Also: `/faq` 404s live despite `next.config.js` already having the correct redirect — just needs a redeploy.

Everything is written to `.seoagent/` (`audit/latest.md`, `strategy/migration-plan.md`, `roadmap.md`, `context.md`, `changelog.md`) so this builds on itself next session — next up would be forward keyword research for Lumina's actual positioning, once there's a real post source to write into.
